threads.body: The `setup-uv` pin is duplicated across many workflows (and also in a composite action). This makes future bumps error-prone and verbose. Consider introducing a local wrapper composite action (e.g., `.github/actions/setup-uv/action.yml`) that internally pins `astral-sh/setup-uv@<sha>`, and then replace these occurrences with `uses: ./.github/actions/setup-uv` so the version is updated in one place.

threads.body: Because this is pinned by SHA and annotated with a human-readable version comment, it’s easy for the comment (`# v10.0.1`) to drift from the actual commit over time. To keep this verifiable, consider linking to the upstream release/tag in the comment (or adding a lightweight check in the bump process) so reviewers can confirm the SHA corresponds to the intended release.
